title: Teodoro pushes for expansion of Philippine Marine Corps
summary: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. called for the expansion of the Philippine Marine Corps (PMC), saying its current force structure is not enough to cover the country’s more than 7,600 islands.
